Standing in solidarity with @UAW workers as they fight for proper pay, wages, and treatment.

The American economy is built on the back of our auto workers, and I will always support their right to unionize and hold their employers accountable. #StandUpUAW

Substance use & mental health disorders affect families in every community, & I'm proud to join my colleagues for #CongressGoesPurple to help spread awareness & save lives.

If you're struggling, don't be afraid to ask for help. Recovery is possible. Visit https://t.co/loBdhKDiBE https://t.co/g2mo4ecpll

Sickle Cell is the most common blood disorder in the US, affecting over 100,000 Americans, but many people are unaware if they have SCD.

This #SickleCellAwarenessMonth, it’s important to raise awareness about SCD signs, symptoms, & treatments. Learn more: https://t.co/N3Jowfoes6

ICYMI: Thanks to @VP & the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, $285M is coming to help schools nationwide hire & train mental health counselors.

This federal funding prioritizes the well-being & safety of our students & will assist w/ diagnosis & treatment of mental health issues.

Black communities continue to be disproportionately impacted by the HIV/AIDS epidemic.

In Congress, I’m working to close the gap & expand access to testing, prevention, and treatment that will save lives & provide every person with the critical health services they need. #NBHAAD https://t.co/yhRKP5XZSQ

Women of color are more likely to suffer from uterine fibroids & experience severe symptoms that can impact fertility.

I’m proud to cosponsor @RepShontelBrown’s #UFIGHT Act, which authorizes federal grants for early detection, treatment, & research to address racial disparities. https://t.co/7UEz1yjP85

This week, I introduced a resolution designating June as Brain & Spine Metastasis Awareness Month.

Metastatic cancer is the leading cause of mortality in patients with cancer—we must improve awareness & access to lifesaving care & treatment.

Read more⤵️
https://t.co/HcFxzAWC3z

It was great meeting with SE Community Resources to discuss how their @USDA grant award will help youth treatment & services in #NC04.

I'm glad to see @POTUS continue to prioritize local organizations that are addressing inequities in economic development, housing & health care. https://t.co/wndI4AREC6

Open enrollment for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act is here, and for the first time ever, #DACA recipients can apply for coverage!

Apply anytime between now and January 15. Learn more and enroll at https://t.co/bQimLgAfej. https://t.co/1yfLqMSMnA

🚨 ICYMI: Medicare Open Enrollment is still open. Don’t wait to get the coverage you need!

Open enrollment runs now until December 7. Visit https://t.co/fNEm8j9JK5 to choose the options that are right for you. https://t.co/7PJBckTWkX

🚨REMINDER: Healthcare Open Enrollment is open until January 15!

Whether you are looking for new coverage or to update your existing plan—now is the time to act.

Coverage is more affordable than ever through the ACA marketplace. Explore your options at https://t.co/OY8Abc6FP5 https://t.co/O9MqUIO1E9

Happy to hear that @Amgen is investing a further $1 billion in the Research Triangle area to expand its biologic manufacturing operation.

This investment will bring transformative medicines to patients around the world and create good-paying jobs in the region for years to come.

Great news! $1 million in federal funding is coming to NC to bolster mental health and substance use treatment across the state.

Mental health and substance use support should be accessible for all, and this funding is a major step in that direction.

https://t.co/DuFNhtiiV0

🚨 Healthcare Open Enrollment closes TODAY, January 15!

If you are looking for new coverage or to update your existing plan—now is the time to act.

Coverage is more affordable than ever through the ACA marketplace. Explore your options at https://t.co/bQimLgAfej https://t.co/fhXQLaIc0w

This week, the House is voting on a $1 trillion cut to Medicaid which provides health coverage to 2 million North Carolinians.

This is a betrayal of the American people, and I hope a few Republicans show some courage and finally join us in stopping this outrageous budget scheme.

Every person has the right to choose their health providers without interference.

I’m proud to join 237 of my colleagues in filing a bicameral amicus brief to defend the rights of millions of Medicaid patients who depend on Planned Parenthood for essential health services and care.

Our amicus brief ⤵️
https://t.co/88xOGZsdQF

42% of children in North Carolina depend on Medicaid for health coverage.

As Republicans try to slash Medicaid, I will continue fighting to protect this support system which acts as a critical lifeline for so many Americans. #MedicaidMatters

An estimated 6 million Americans have an unruptured brain aneurysm, but funding for research surrounding this condition has long been inadequate.

I was proud to meet with @BAFOUND and the family of Ellie Helton as we work to pass Ellie's Law and bolster research and treatment efforts.

During National Nurses Week, we recognize all of the hardworking nurses in #NC04 and around the country.

Thank you for your tireless dedication to your patients and commitment to providing lifesaving care for all. https://t.co/RcelFm9eAt

I am saddened to hear of President Biden's cancer diagnosis.

My thoughts are with the Biden family and their loved ones during this difficult time, and I'm praying for his full and speedy recovery.

I met with @AAMCtoday to discuss the essential role our medical institutions play in improving the health of patients and communities across North Carolina.

We must ensure @NIH and our medical colleges have the funding they need to continue delivering lifesaving research and care nationwide.

The GOP is still trying to pass their tax package that will strip health care coverage from millions of Americans. 

Over 600,000 people in NC alone will lose their health insurance. I'll say it again: Trump's Big, Ugly Bill puts lives at risk.

I reintroduced my resolution designating June as Brain and Spine Metastasis Awareness Month.

Metastatic cancer remains the leading cause of mortality in patients with cancer, and Congress needs to improve access to lifesaving care.

Read More:
https://t.co/HcFxzAWC3z

As I've said, the Republican's Big Billionaire Bill will put the health care coverage of over a half-million North Carolinians at risk.

Don't just take it from me ⤵️

The GOP's FY26 MilCon VA funding bill will shortchange American heroes to fund kickbacks for Trump's billionaire buddies.

Privatizing VA care and underfunding military infrastructure to funnel billions to corporate hospitals doesn’t support our veterans—it breaks our promise to those who served.
